agent.problem: The earlier cards only say that Jesus gives Peter a job. They provide no basis for choosing lambs over goats or camels, so this blank asks the baker to guess unseen wording rather than reason out the meaning.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
